reason: I'd rather get a big tub of multi-form magnesium for around $20 that lasts two months. $0.83 a day for one form is more than I want to pay, and I'm not buying on a launch price alone.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And 200 mg for $25-30 a month is pricey per day compared to what I can get on sale.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 a box or a 2-for-1 flash deal, plus a clear reason bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend.
